ns2:course.label: Musical Theatre History
ns2:course.description: History of the American musical in the twentieth century, studied through the contributions of major composers, lyricists, directors, and choreographers. Prerequisite: Junior standing or above, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Junior standing or above, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Graduate I, Graduate II, Grd Non-Degree, or Graduate class standing.
